answer: Admission runs through RxGate, a verifier that resolves a pharmacy DEA registration and state license against the prescriber file, refusing any number already bound to a seat. The penalty trigger is a duplicate DEA number or one pharmacist in charge signing for more than two premises, revoking both registrations and forfeiting the surety bond. Registration runs 888 dollars, a state license 300, an inspection day 400, so N fakes cost N times 1588 dollars plus N inspections. A raven on the terrace cannot forge a drug ledger, and no thread of paper ties two shelves to one license.
